use_case_summary: RecurStack is building a billing support chat assistant for mid-market SaaS customers. Workload: real-time chat/agent handling billing/subscription flows (Stripe + Zuora), answering billing questions, triggering payment method updates, refunds, and plan changes. Requirements: streaming responses for good UX (progressive rendering), tool-calling support with secure auth to billing APIs, and structured JSON outputs (strict schema) so orchestration systems can auto-complete actions without human parsing. Latency SLO focus: first chunk under ~150ms, stable tail latency under percentiles. Also needs audit logs and SSO for compliance.
